files.raw.json: Verbatim contents of the three data files the site fetches, keyed by filename.
files.table_2026_06_25.csv: Verbatim source: per-model, per-subtask scores (23 subtasks). Model ids are API ids, not display names.
files.categories_2026_06_25.json: Verbatim source: mapping of the 7 categories to their subtasks.
files.cost_2026_06_25.csv: Verbatim source: per-model, per-subtask cost and nq_* (question count) columns.
files.raw_leaderboard_dom.json: DOM extraction of the rendered leaderboard: aggregated category scores, org and cost per successful task, which the CSVs do not contain pre-aggregated. (Not persisted as a separate file in this scrape; folded directly into normalized.json.)
files.normalized.json: One record per model per metric.

notes: Data endpoints discovered via performance resource entries: livebench.ai/table_2026_06_25.csv, categories_2026_06_25.json, cost_2026_06_25.csv (all ?v=1788377630, a newer cache-busting version than the 20260902 scrape's ?v=1788285879 — same release date, 2026-06-25).

The site's rendered leaderboard aggregates the subtask CSV into the 7 categories plus Overall; those aggregates were read from the DOM, so normalized.json is DOM-derived while raw.json is the untouched network source.
49 models shown by default; 'Include finetunes' adds 1 more (Smaug-Agentic), flagged with is_finetune. Both are included, 50 models total.
'Show org' was enabled to obtain the provider column.
cost_usd is the site's model-level 'COST PER SUCCESSFUL TASK' in USD. It is not per-category; it is repeated on every record of a model.
date is the LiveBench release date the scores belong to (2026-06-25), not a model release date.
rank is present only on Overall records, taken from the site's default Overall-descending sort. The site shows no per-category rank, so it is omitted there.
context_window is not published by LiveBench and is omitted.
An older release (2024-06-24, v1) is selectable on the site but was not captured; only the latest release was scraped.
Per-subtask scores are preserved in the raw CSVs but not expanded into normalized.json.
No 'Muse Spark 1.3' entry exists on the site as of this scrape; only 'Muse Spark 1.2 xHigh Effort' and 'Muse Spark 1.1 xHigh Effort' are present (unchanged vs 20260902).
No entry named exactly 'Gemini 3.8 Flash' exists; the site lists 'Gemini 3.8 Flash High' (verified: it is a new addition vs 20260902, see changes_vs_20260902).
changes_vs_20260902: Model count grew from 49 to 50 (default-shown models grew from 48 to 49; the single finetune, Smaug-Agentic, is unchanged). The added model is 'Gemini 3.8 Flash High' (Google, open_weights=false): Overall 75.8, Reasoning 89.3, Coding 72.5, Agentic Coding 54.2, Mathematics 91.6, Data Analysis 54.0, Language 87.8, Instruction Following 81.4, cost_usd 0.307. No 'Muse Spark 1.3' model exists on either date.
